freeze.note: Fill by a second commit after committing this file, code/, and new_pool_audit.json; never edit other blocks afterwards.

question: Does M3 + threshold-variance-reduction acquisition (frozen auxiliary T posterior) select labels more efficiently than M3 + probability margin on the independently generated unseen pool?

population.source: new SPH simulations at fixed locations; inputs manifest only available to method code
population.context: z = (log VX, log LS, ST) standardised on each outer training pool
population.exclusions: none; rows with unparseable inputs are reported, not silently removed

feasibility_gate.fold_rule: largest K in {5,4,3,2} with N/K >= 85 else K=2
feasibility_gate.horizon_rule: H = min(80, floor(0.8 * n_train)); acquisition study infeasible if H < 40

partitions.splitter: seeded K-fold over groups, no label stratification

initial_design.method: feature-only maximin in standardised (P,VX,LS,ST) of the outer training pool, repository w85.initial_design logic
initial_design.one_class_startup: continue predetermined feature-only maximin sequence for all arms until both classes appear; charged to budget; smoothed-prevalence prediction during startup; if none by H, run kept as non-diverging

M3.definition: Phase 1.13/1.14 repository implementation: Stage-1 logistic (C=1e6) on standardised log h of revealed rows, frozen; Stage-2 Laplace logistic GPC with ARD Matern-3/2 discrepancy on standardised (P,VX,LS,ST), residual sd in [0.05,1], length scales in [0.01,100], L-BFGS-B, no restarts

T_auxiliary_posterior.definition: probit GPC on g = c (logh - tau(z)); tau ~ N(mu0, s_mu^2) + N(0, s_beta^2) z + GP(0, s_u^2 Matern32_ARD(z; ls)); Laplace inference; used only to score candidates

Bprime.acquisition: probability margin of the frozen T posterior

C.acquisition: expected threshold-variance reduction phi(t)^2/(Phi(t)(1-Phi(t))(1+v))*sum_ref Cov^2 under frozen T; reference set = whole outer training pool; candidates = unrevealed training rows

D.acquisition: matched Random continuation, 10 seeded continuations per run

arms.selection_rule: argmax; tie-break smallest population row index; batch size 1

secondary.metric: full-fold accuracy at B40 and BH
budget to sustained q20 accuracy >= 0.80/0.82/0.84 over three consecutive checkpoints

endpoints.evaluation_subset_definition: B1 = nearest opposite-label distance in population-standardised (P,VX,LS,ST) using all new-pool labels inside the isolated evaluator; q20/q30 = smallest ceil(0.2/0.3 * n_test) B1 distances per fold; evaluation-only
endpoints.primary_window_justification: old-pool headroom to full-label ceiling 0.031 over B16-40 vs 0.0005 over B41-80; power 0.82 vs 0.42 for an early-decaying effect of amplitude 0.02 (results/window_power.csv)

success_criteria.success: paired repeat-block 95% interval lower bound > 0 AND point estimate >= +0.010 on the primary contrast AND KH-recall guard not violated

analysis.random_arm: average of 10 continuations per run before pairing

blinding.access_log: append-only JSONL: timestamp, seq, run_id, ids
blinding.reveal_scope: only ids in the requesting run's training pool
blinding.evaluator_isolation: held-out labels and B1/q flags never returned to method code
blinding.preregistered_label_applies_only_if: freeze block filled before any new label is read by method-side personnel

code.dependencies: repository commit bf4782881bc27fe1ec5256dc3ba0516478a1ed13 src/ modules; numpy, scipy, scikit-learn, pandas
